scenes.big: One eye can quietly fall behind
scenes.en: Lazy eye must be caught early.
scenes.say: In some children, one eye quietly falls behind. It's called lazy eye, and it has to be caught early.

scenes.en: If one eye is blurry or turned, the brain starts ignoring it.
scenes.say: Vision develops in early childhood. If one eye is blurry or turned, the brain starts using only the stronger eye, and ignores the weaker one.

scenes.en: Treatment works best when started young, ideally before about age 7.
scenes.ta: சிறு வயதிலேயே சிகிச்சை தொடங்கினால் நல்ல பலன்
scenes.say: Did you know? Treatment works best when it starts young, ideally before about seven years of age. Later, it gets much harder.

scenes.en: Often bumps into things, or struggles to catch a ball.
scenes.say: Sign one: often bumping into things, or trouble catching a ball.

scenes.en: Tilts the head or closes one eye to look.
scenes.ta: தலை சாய்த்து அல்லது ஒரு கண்ணை மூடி பார்த்தல்
scenes.say: Sign two: tilting the head, or closing one eye to see better.

scenes.en: An eye drifts in or out, or the child gets upset when one eye is covered.
scenes.ta: ஒரு கண் விலகுதல், ஒரு கண்ணை மூடினால் அழுதல்
scenes.say: Sign three: an eye that drifts in or out, or the child gets upset when you cover one eye, but not the other.

scenes.en: Often there are no signs. Test by age 3 to 5, and before school.
scenes.say: Often there are no signs at all. So get your child's eyes tested by age three to five, and before school. If an eye turns, see an eye specialist soon.
